entry.title: Create a station
entry.description: Check your organization’s prerequisites before starting the technical setup.
entry.loadingDescription: We are checking that your organization can start setting up a station.
entry.verificationFailed: The check could not be completed
entry.readyDescription: The catalog contains at least one active product. Next, select the products used by this station.
entry.productRequiredTitle: You must configure at least one product before creating a station.
entry.productRequiredDescription: Categories and products form the organization’s permanent catalog and will be reused across all your stations.

wizard.restoringDescription: We are reloading the station saved in this draft.
wizard.draftUnavailable: The previous draft is no longer available. Please start creating the station again.
wizard.productsSaveFailed: Unable to save the product selection.
wizard.configurationChanged: The configuration has changed and must be corrected before completion.
wizard.commissioningFailed: Unable to complete the technical setup.

station.title: Station information
station.description: Create the station’s identity and main contact details.

products.title: Products used at this station
products.description: Select the products from the organization catalog that will be used at this station.
products.help: The catalog is managed from the Products dashboard. This step is only for selecting the products used at this station.
products.emptyTitle: No products have been configured in your catalog yet.
products.emptyDescription: Add categories and products to the organization’s permanent catalog, then return to this step.

depots.emptyDescription: Create this station’s first depot so tanks can be attached to it.

tanks.description: Configure each depot’s tanks and their associated products.

pumps.description: Configure the station’s physical dispensers and their metering mode.
pumps.help: Pump-level metering is suitable for nozzles supplied by the same tank. Choose nozzle-level metering when each point must be tracked independently.
pumps.emptyDescription: Create this station’s first physical dispenser.

points.description: Configure the physical dispensing points associated with the pumps.
points.help: Each nozzle belongs to a pump. The metering mode selected on the pump determines where its meter is configured.
points.pumpMeterMessage: This pump’s metering will be configured globally in the Meters step.
points.pointMeterMessage: This pump’s meters will be configured by nozzle in the Meters step.
points.empty: No nozzle configured for this pump.
points.requirement: Add at least one nozzle to each pump before continuing.

meters.description: Configure the meters used to track dispensing readings.
meters.help: The metering level set on each pump determines whether the meter is global to the pump or individual to each nozzle.
meters.configurePump: Configure the global meter for pump {{name}}.
meters.addPoint: Add at least one nozzle to pump {{name}}.

review.description: Review the entire setup before commissioning.
review.persisted: The displayed data was reloaded from the persisted configuration.
review.noProduct: No product selected in the wizard.
review.selectProduct: Select at least one product for this station.
review.ready: The persisted configuration is complete and ready for commissioning.

commissioning.completeDescription: Continue with pricing and operational setup before starting operations.
commissioning.pricingLater: Pricing is the next setup step. Its interface will be available in a future release.
commissioning.title: Technical commissioning
commissioning.description: Your station’s technical setup is complete.
commissioning.help: FuelFlex checks the station structure, its depots, tanks, pumps, nozzles and meters. You can then continue with operational setup, including pricing and user assignments.
